### Authorship

Using AI is completely fine and encouraged, especially for reviewing your changes. We ask
so we can route the review: agent-authored code gets an agent review first, while
hand-written code deserves the respect of a human reviewer. Either way, a human who
understands the change must be able to answer questions about it.

- [ ] Written by hand. I would like a human review.
- [ ] Mostly or partially generated by an AI agent, which I reviewed and understand.
